# LCA ball joint removal from knuckle

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Drive the LCA ball joint out of the knuckle with a hammer and grade eight bolt. [t856]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] If space is tight, drive the ball joint out on a workbench by removing the entire LCA and spindle assembly first. [t856]
- [Partial] Use a wedge driven into the back of the knuckle to spread it slightly if the bolt won't budge. [t856]
